messages.subject: Professional R Shiny App
parts:
Hello,

I was wondering if anyone knew of any examples of professional r shiny applications (for sale). I've been working on an R shiny application for the past 5 months or so, and want to eventually sell licenses for people to access it. I was wondering if this is a reasonable goal - I understand I will need to get the R shiny Pro server eventually (can't afford it at the moment), and speed is also an issue so I would be interested in parallelizing a lot of the code. 

I'm a little concerned that R shiny isn't really built for this sort of thing, but right now I can't see any downsides besides the speed issue. It does some pretty computationally intense things (like running random forest hundreds of times, k-means clustering, etc), so I'm not sure what most users would be expecting.

Thanks,
Luke
